step.command: if [ "x$BPFREJIT_DUMP_LIVE_JIT" = "x1" ]; then bpftool prog show id ${PROG_ID} > ${WORKDIR}/live_prog_show.txt; bpftool -j prog show id ${PROG_ID} > ${WORKDIR}/live_prog_show.json; bpftool prog dump xlated id ${PROG_ID} > ${WORKDIR}/live_xlated.disasm; bpftool prog dump jited id ${PROG_ID} file ${WORKDIR}/live_jited.bin; chmod 0644 ${WORKDIR}/live_jited.bin; arch=$(uname -m); case "$arch" in x86_64|amd64) objdump_machine=i386:x86-64 ;; aarch64|arm64) objdump_machine=aarch64 ;; *) echo "unsupported JIT dump objdump arch: $arch" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; objdump -D -b binary -m "$objdump_machine" ${WORKDIR}/live_jited.bin > ${WORKDIR}/live_jited.objdump; fi; timeout 6000 bpfopt --pass noop --input ${INPUT} --output ${OUTPUT} --report ${REPORT} --prog-type ${PROG_TYPE} --target ${TARGET}; if [ "x$BPFREJIT_DUMP_LIVE_JIT_FAIL" = "x1" ]; then false; fi
step.name: noop
